findings.detail: AUD belongs to the Par/Shares currency marker for the Sonar Acquisitionco row; fair value remains in the schedule's dollar fair-value column.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 single-cell currency flag. The flagged value is fair_value_currency=U_AUD, but the source row places AUD before the par amount under Par/Shares, while Cost and Fair Value are separate columns. Footnote 4 confirms AUD is an exception for par amount denomination, not fair value denomination. Therefore the pipeline leaked the par currency marker into fair_value_currency.
